name: Slip of the Tongue
body:
School enchantment [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target gets words and phrases mixed up, and is unable to express herself clearly.

The target is left unable to cast spells with a verbal component for the duration of slip of the tongue, and also suffers a -2 penalty to all Charisma-based ability and skill checks.
